name: blast-fire-step-visual
description: Redesign P4/#26: the Blast Workshop's Fire step (danger zone, Sound the Horn, pre-flight checklist) and the real fire flow — FIRE opens PreflightModal, DETONATE fires and closes it, BlastReportModal auto-opens with the real report, CLOSE dismisses it.

steps.description: Setup: a fresh site. Staffed opening (#551): a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence, plus an unmanned drill_rig, are hired/purchased for free at game-open — #553's automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: role: bootstrap (issue #515): the Charge step right after this one is the panel's own designated first-open (`#bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"]`, a toggle) — giving this step its own panel-open click would leave the panel open here and then CLOSE it when the charge step's click ran. No dragTiles-based grid-tool conversion was attempted here for that reason, not because one doesn't exist for a 1x1 grid. #553: confirming the grid queues 1 drill_hole PendingAction and pushes 1 PlannedHole into plannedDrillHoles — not drilled yet, so holeCount stays 0 right after confirm.

interaction.command: drill_plan grid origin:10,10 rows:1 cols:1 spacing:3 depth:6

steps.description: #553: drain the ordered plan — the staffed driller/drill_rig lands the single hole well inside this pad (sandbox-measured landing at tick 20).

Declared boomite/5kg/2m is exactly what the Charge panel shows on a fresh page (DEFAULT_EXPLOSIVE/DEFAULT_AMOUNT_KG/DEFAULT_STEMMING_M, Charge.ts), so Charge All commits the declared values with no stepper click at all — asserted rather than assumed. The Blast Workshop is opened here rather than three steps later; autoAdvance is untouched (no tab is clicked anywhere in this file), so the panel still walks itself Drill -> Charge -> Preview -> Fire as the plan completes, which is what the Fire step below checks.
#554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing.

The plan is complete once H1 is charged, so the still-armed autoAdvance walks the already-open Blast Workshop straight to step 5 (Fire). #557 correction: the danger zone is NOT clear here — the single-hole plan's own driller (employee #1) and the drill_rig they drove out on (vehicle #1) both come to rest exactly on top of H1 (10,10) once drilling and charging finish, squarely inside computeDangerZone([H1], BLAST_DANGER_MARGIN_M) (confirmed via direct trace: both sit at (10,10) right at this point) — so Sound the Horn is enabled and the occupant list shows both of them, not the 'nobody nearby' the file used to claim. The toolbar click that used to open the panel here is gone: the panel has been open since the charge step above, and #bs-toolbar [data-panel="blast"] is a toggle (UIManager.togglePanel), so clicking it again would have closed it.
#1362: the Fire step has no Sound the Horn button any more -- DETONATE sounds the horn itself. The occupant list still shows the driller and drill_rig in the zone.
FIRE opens PreflightModal — real plan stats, the 'run analysis' hint (no preview has run), and the all-clear warnings

#1362: DETONATE arms the sequence and sounds the horn. The drill_rig is driverless (auto-dismounted when its drilling finished) so it cannot drive out: the preflight modal switches to its waiting state, names the stranded occupant and offers Fire anyway and Cancel.
Let the driller walk out for real; the stranded rig stays, so the sequence must not auto-fire.

Fire anyway (#1362): the player overrides the stranded-rig wait; the blast fires, the preflight modal closes and BlastReportModal auto-opens with the real report (rating, cleared/cracked/fragments, ore value)

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero
the report modal must hide once closed, same invariant as BlastReportModal's other conversions
